subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge after the Canvas web action-ingress contract lands?
rationale: The request spans product scope and a security boundary: it depends on unmerged dashboard widget work and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Sequence after prerequisites
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the Canvas web action-ingress and dashboard host directions first, then implement the bridge against the approved contracts.

options.title: Fold into Canvas ingress
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 the only canonical work item and close this later only if it explicitly covers dashboard widgets.

options.title: Move out of bundled core
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a core direction, route the idea to an external plugin/ClawHub package after any missing plugin APIs are identified.

recommendation.title: Sequence after prerequisites
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the Canvas web action-ingress and dashboard host directions first, then implement the bridge against the approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest visible routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab precedent and adjacent web-widget product direction.
